police.speaker: Detective Morris
police.text: We will verify the roadside fuel transaction and keep its source intact. A lead is not a rescue; we cannot assume Victor stayed there.

signal.speaker: David
signal.text: I will check the technical trail behind the roadside fuel transaction. Amara, tell me what the records cannot explain.

alone.speaker: David
alone.text: I am following the roadside fuel transaction without police backup. Amara has my location; I am not going to turn this into a contest with Victor.

dialogues.speaker: David
dialogues.text: The next lead is the roadside fuel transaction. We need its original source before Victor moves again.

dialogues.speaker: Amara
dialogues.text: Victor used to tell that club every good thing in my life was his doing.
